name: secrets
description: Save and read passwords, login codes, and passkeys. secrets_list shows names only. It does not show the secret. secrets_get returns the password or the current login code. Call get only when you need the value. secrets_set saves one. A one-time code is type totp. A passkey is for signing into a website without a password. secrets_import accepts 1Password-style CSV or legacy 1Password unencrypted JSON; secrets_export writes a CSV (Title,URL,Username,Password,OTPAuth,Notes) under /home/bia/files. Files live in /home/bia/files/state/passwords.json.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|save this github token -> discover(path='mcp/secrets', enable=true); secrets_set(description='GitHub token', type='string', value='ghp_…')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|what is the github login code -> secrets_get(id='GitHub 2FA')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|save this otpauth URL -> secrets_set(description='GitHub 2FA', value='otpauth://totp/…')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|make a passkey for github.com as octocat -> secrets_passkey_create(description='GitHub passkey', rp_id='github.com', user_name='octocat')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|export gmail to csv for 1password -> secrets_export(id='Gmail password', path='outbox/gmail.csv')
